scope: Owned presuppositionless metalogic continuation only; philosophical candidate and formal audit separated

shared_fragments.text: **元逻辑的直接奠基 / Direct grounding of metalogic，2026-10-08。** 按 Ren 明确认可，[同一规则候选与反审](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/REFLECTIVE-IDENTITY-INTEGRATION.md)从直接承接根据说明 P ⊢ P，检验混合认可标准、推理接续及任意自我担保。11项 Lean 形式审计通过、命名公理报告全空。/ A positive constitutive candidate, not a completed assumption-free foundation. The remaining inference concerns warranted recognition of the same content and ground, then hypothetical application/substitution; earlier conditional logic results remain complete. [Current section 13](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md#reflective-identity).

**无预设元逻辑路线 / Presuppositionless metalogic，2026-10-08。** [第13节](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md#reflective-identity)提出同一规则的构成性根据候选；11项实查审计区分保留根据、提高认可标准、接续和自我担保。/ Ren authorizes the stronger investigation. A same-standard identity candidate advances the argument; the whole foundation remains unproved, not ruled out by the use of inference itself.

**同一规则与无预设奠基 / Identity and presuppositionless grounding，2026-10-08。** [肯定论证、原典与作者反审](REFLECTIVE-IDENTITY-INTEGRATION.md)形成首个具体规则候选，11项新 Lean 审计全空。/ Grounds are retained under the stated assessment; mixed criteria and a Curry pattern test overgeneralization. The philosophical warrant of content/ground recognition and the remaining metalogic remain open. Existing InferentialGrounds and prior conditional logic results are reused.

**Reflective identity, 8 October 2026.** [ReflectiveIdentity.lean](ReflectiveIdentity.lean) and [checker](check_reflective_identity.py) provide 11 small, empty-dependency theorem audits: retained grounds, exact criterion inclusion for identity, changed-standard and composition controls, and a Curry fixed-point consequence. [Philosophical integration](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/REFLECTIVE-IDENTITY-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes the constitutive candidate from its formal representation. No certification of Lean's own foundation or new logic is claimed.

**同一规则的奠基候选 / Identity-grounding candidate，2026-10-08。** F01成对接入[论证、两个过度推广检验与反审](REFLECTIVE-IDENTITY-INTEGRATION.md)，11项形式审计全空，保留完整无预设目标未完成。/ Only the owned F01 suffix/links, read/authored versions and one discovery page change. Prior entry content, other rows and pending reviews remain. [Edits](REFLECTIVE-IDENTITY-INDEX-EDITS.json); [scoped checks](REFLECTIVE-IDENTITY-CHECKS.json). No full-table or independent acceptance.

entry_before.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_before.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。 第二轮从原生占用规律推出局部历史允许的固定上下文精确判据；单相关支承位摘要保留所选工作负载的执行与整体事件步数预算。 第三轮证明：当前接入相同，允许改接范围内占用一致，当且仅当全部允许有限历史可行性一致。 第四轮将有来源保证的记录与逐位置核对接到同一原生取得过程；任意有限执行投影合法，并保留取得／使用预算。
entry_before.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success. A continuation derives the exact frozen-context criterion from native occupancy laws; a relevant-slot summary preserves selected execution and merged-state event-count budgets. A third round proves that, at equal current routes, agreement on permitted-slot occupancy is equivalent to agreement on every allowed finite-word feasibility judgment. A fourth round connects maintained records and per-slot validation to the same native acquisition process, proving finite-trace projection and separate acquisition/use accounting.
entry_before.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；第一轮提出的上下文与摘要目标已由本次有范围结果接续。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。 新37项定理／220项闭包审计（124空）；新证明无经典选择。初始完整相容性、局部历史与固定占用条件明示；总量摘要失败，单支承摘要不能认证遗漏位置的相容性。整体预算不等于保持其他占用的准备，步数不等于真实时间。Iris/Leaf已有先例，仍属完成的整合而非新颖性证明。 新24项定理／42项总审计（30空）；原生三步历史产生旧工作负载等价、扩展范围可区分的配置。旧摘要加目的地不足以总能更新摘要。允许范围、原子性和身份给定；不禁止无损编码，未解决新读数取得或确立前沿新颖性。已完成交错研究直接复用。 新28项定理／70项闭包审计（38空）；新证明8空、20仅标准依赖，无经典选择。无关改变可继续；指定n次失效后读取／使用需n+2单位，任意有限预算有耗尽见证。原子可信读取、全部写入版本维护及原子核对／使用给定；此局部连接已完成，现实对应及新颖性未证。
entry_before.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; the first-round context/abstraction target is continued by the scoped results below. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate. Continuation: 37 new theorems / 220 closure audits (124 empty), no new choice dependency. Full initial compatibility, a valid local history and a frozen frame are explicit. Counts lose readiness; the selected summary loses hidden-slot compatibility. Merged-state budgets do not imply preparation preserving held occupancy, and steps are not physical time. Iris/Leaf precedents remain credited; the scoped integration is complete, without a novelty claim. Reconfiguration: 24 new theorems / 42 total audits (30 empty). A native three-event history witnesses old-workload equivalence and separation under wider access; old active-view plus destination cannot always determine the new view. Permission scope, identities and atomicity remain supplied. Lossless encodings remain possible; observation acquisition and novelty are not established. Completed interleaving work is reused. Acquired-use continuation: 28 new theorems / 70 closure audits (38 empty); new reports are 8 empty and 20 standard only, with no choice. Unrelated change is allowed; n specified invalidation cycles then read/use cost n+2 units, and every finite budget has an exhaustion witness. Coherent atomic reads, full writer revision maintenance and atomic validate/use remain supplied. This local bridge is complete; realization and novelty are not established.
